script:
set -eu
mkdir -p /workspace/demo
cd /workspace/demo
printf '#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){puts("hello");return 0;}\n' > main.c
clang main.c -o hello.wasm
./hello.wasm | grep hello > result.txt
cat result.txt
interruptScript:
set -u
mkdir -p /workspace/demo
cd /workspace/demo
printf 'int main(void){for(;;){}}\n' > spin.c
clang spin.c -o spin.wasm
./spin.wasm; printf 'spin=%d\n' "$?"
printf '#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){puts("hello");return 0;}\n' > main.c
clang main.c -o interrupted.wasm; printf 'clang=%d\n' "$?"
if [ -e interrupted.wasm ]; then echo kept; else echo discarded; fi
clang main.c -o hello.wasm && ./hello.wasm

cacheScope: Asset responses are no-store; the warm run is a new owner Worker, container and package manager in the same browser profile
networkScope: Trusted local bootstrap and origin/asset allowlist; no guest/network security qualification
workerObservationScope: All dedicated Workers in this exclusively owned Chromium browser
